problem.observed_gap: the training sequence schema contains terminal labels and official-resolution identity, so it cannot be used to generate a prediction panel before one-use selection-target access
problem.prohibited_response: selection labels, winning-token evidence, resolution hashes, auxiliary future targets, or target-bearing dataset identity must not enter sequence inference
problem.required_response: materialize an independently hash-bound target-free selection tensor from causal feature snapshots only

research_basis.finding: time-series sequences constructed before the evaluation split can leak future information and materially distort reported performance
research_basis.design_consequence: selection inference receives only its already-partitioned causal feature history and never a target-bearing sequence object

research_basis.finding: financial backtest leakage can materially alter measured performance and must be controlled with explicit chronological and embargo boundaries
research_basis.design_consequence: the existing purged chronological roles remain unchanged and this contract adds a hard object-level target boundary

selection_inference.endpoint_selection: the unchanged target-blind four-phase hash-ranked endpoint selector
selection_inference.gap_behavior: reset history at every missing 250 millisecond receipt
selection_inference.normalization: the exact training-role median and interquartile transform bound by its SHA-256

integrity.arrays: little-endian contiguous read-only float32 sequence tensor, float64 prior vector, and int64 decision times
integrity.source_binding: each endpoint and causal history is hash-bound and the complete condition feature chain is reduced to one manifest SHA-256
integrity.receipt_binding: every batch carries the terminal receipt-audit SHA-256 supplied by the target-free materializer
integrity.candidate_prediction_order: the sequence output must be joined to the prediction panel by exact condition, decision time, endpoint source chain, and frozen candidate order
